failure_analysis: P5p successfully repaired P5o's empty-root ambiguity: the durable receipts prove launch, clean initial process guard, failed EXCLUSIVE_PROCESS permission attempt, and entry into pool 0.

The checkpoint unit remained too coarse: one entire pool contains analytic extraction plus five frozen models before a completion receipt, leaving many hours of work without a recoverable scientific unit.
The generator and historical execution assumptions were path-bound to C:, so external storage relocation remained an untested infrastructure hazard.
next_allowed_action: A P5 successor may change only execution durability and path portability: derive project root at runtime, validate all artifacts after relocation, checkpoint immutable analytic inputs and each model result, and validate interruption classification without CUDA or performance data before generating wholly new identities.
